explication: MHR is a parametric human-rig package: callers provide identity, pose, and expression parameters and receive mesh vertices and skeleton state. Supporting branches convert between MHR and SMPL-family models, provide mesh utilities, and offer a local web viewer. The model-loading and inference path is shown in sampled source; conversion and viewer internals are only partially sampled, so uncertain connections are omitted or marked unverified.
